data.summary: Stadtwerke Musterstadt GmbH sent a final electricity bill (Schlussrechnung) after your move-out, for 1 January–31 March 2026. The total is €105.58, payable within 30 days of the invoice date (14 April 2026).
data.explanation: This is the final bill for your electricity at Lindenweg 12, issued because you moved out. It covers 212 kWh of extra consumption plus the base fee, totalling €105.58 including 19% VAT. Payment is due within 30 days of the invoice date, and the app shows the exact date. Transfer the amount to the IBAN printed on the invoice, quoting the invoice number. If unpaid, you may receive a reminder with extra costs. Check the amount against your meter readings if unsure.
